description: Magic link case (a): navigate to https://<MYS_STORE_DOMAIN>/apps/mysbox/orders with NO ?parameters= (guest, storefront password cookie present)
redaction: no buyer PII, no tokens, no .env values; store host written as <MYS_STORE_DOMAIN>

requests.status: 3xx (redirect; probed with fetch redirect:manual -> type opaqueredirect, status 0)

visible_text: Sign in or create an account
